# Typerite

> The easiest way to write is to let something think for you. This is the other way.

## What is Typerite?
Typerite is a distraction-free daily writing tool designed to build focus and cognitive clarity. It counters the trend of AI-generated content by forcing you to write 500 words per day manually.

## Core Philosophy
- **Earned Words**: Only words you type count. Paste is disabled.
- **No AI, No Prompts**: Just a blank page and a cursor.
- **Restoration**: If you miss a day, you can restore your streak by writing more the next day.
- **Privacy**: All writing is stored locally on your device and encrypted. No analytics, no tracking.

## Platforms
- iOS
- iPadOS
- macOS
